scope.title: Scope name
scope.description: Name of the global scope for this application. Define an organisational tenant.

cluster.title: Cluster name
cluster.description: Name of the cluster running this application. Define a platform tenant.

environment.title: Environement name
environment.description: Name of the environement for this application. Define a stage tenant.

component.title: Component name
component.description: Name of the component consisting of this application. Define a logical tenant.

app.title: Application name
app.description: Name of the application name. Define a functionnal tenant.

version.title: Version name
version.description: Name of the application version. Define this deployment version. Should be incremented each time application configuration is changed to keep track of changes and allow ease rollin of the application (and rollout in case of problem). Default use Chart appVersion.

application.title: ArgoCD Applications
application.description: Configuration of ArgoCD Application resources to deploy

list.title: Application list
list.description: List of ArgoCD applications to deploy

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where to deploy this application (default is project namespace)

finalizer.title: Enable ArgoCD finalizer
finalizer.description: Enable resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io finalizer for this application

wave.title: Sync wave
wave.description: ArgoCD sync-wave annotation for deployment order

server.title: Destination server
server.description: Kubernetes API server URL for deployment destination

source.title: Source configuration
source.description: Git repository and path configuration for the application source

repo.title: Repository URL
repo.description: Git repository URL containing the application code

rev.title: Revision
rev.description: Git branch, tag or commit hash to use

path.title: Path
path.description: Path within the repository to the application manifests or Helm chart

helm.title: Helm configuration
helm.description: Helm source configuration (valueFiles, parameters) as YAML literal block
examples:
valueFiles:
  - values.yaml
parameters:
  - name: context.scope
    value: "myscope"

syncPolicy.title: Sync policy
syncPolicy.description: ArgoCD sync policy configuration (automated, syncOptions, retry) as YAML literal block
examples:
automated:
  prune: true
  selfHeal: true
syncOptions:
  - CreateNamespace=false

ignoreDifferences.title: Ignore differences
ignoreDifferences.description: ArgoCD ignoreDifferences configuration for fields to ignore during sync as YAML literal block

argocd_repocreds.title: ArgoCD repository credentials
argocd_repocreds.description: Configuration of repository credentials for private Git repositories

enabled.title: Enable repository credentials
enabled.description: Enable deployment of repository credential secrets

list.title: Repository credentials list
list.description: List of repository credentials to create

name.title: Credential name
name.description: Name of the repository credentials secret

shortname.title: Short name
shortname.description: Short name for ArgoCD to reference these credentials

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where the secret will be created

url.title: Repository URL
url.description: URL of the repository (or base path for multiple repositories)

secretType.title: Secret type
secretType.description: ArgoCD secret type (repository, repo-creds, or cluster)

type.title: Credentials type
type.description: Type of credentials (https, ssh, or githubapp)

sshOptions.title: SSH options
sshOptions.description: SSH private key for SSH authentication

sshPrivateKey.title: SSH private key
sshPrivateKey.description: SSH private key in PEM format

githubAppPrivateKey.title: GitHub App private key
githubAppPrivateKey.description: GitHub App private key in PEM format

enabled.description: Enable deployment of the ArgoCD cluster resource

spec.description: ArgoCD cluster specification as YAML (server config, HA, redis, dex, grafana, prometheus, repo settings)
